title: Race to tame inflation more tricky that one that stops the nation
paragraphs: The Melbourne Cup is one of the best and worst places to discuss monetary policy.
At 2.30pm on a spring Tuesday no-one is thinking about of the Reserve Bank boardroom.

Robbie Williams has just walked off-stage to thunderous cheers in the crowd. The bars that opened at 10.30am are busy selling prosecco by the bottle and pre-mixed cans of spirits in a cardboard carry tray that holds four.
